records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total revenue decreased by $196 million in 2023, or 1%, when compared to the previous year primarily due to decreases in other revenue, lower fuel recovery, pricing declines in export coal due to the impact of lower benchmark rates and declines in intermodal volume.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: These declines were partially offset by pricing and volume gains in merchandise and higher coal volumes.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Trucking revenue decreased $84 million versus the prior year due to lower fuel and capacity surcharges.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: • Expenses of $9.1 billion increased $266 million or 3% year over year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: • Operating income of $5.6 billion decreased $462 million or 8% year over year.
